verdict.rationale: Ollama's docs say OpenAI clients can connect to it and that it supports a subset of the OpenAI API. Its OpenAPI spec places the HTTP API on a local server at http://localhost:11434, so a local OpenAI-compatible endpoint is a first-party capability. However, compatibility is explicitly only a subset of the OpenAI API, and the pack never shows that it works for any loaded model. missing for 10: documentation of which OpenAI endpoints and features are covered, explicit confirmation that every local model is served through the OpenAI-compatible endpoint, documentation of how the server is started, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can launch a local OpenAI-compatible API server for any loaded model

citations.quote: Connect OpenAI clients to Ollama. Ollama supports a subset of the OpenAI API
Ollama has a REST API for running and managing models.
